items.title: Steel Dynamics Says Imports Are Rising, Even With Big Tariffs
items.summary: Steel imports from Asia are rising even with the 50% U.S. tariff intended to keep foreign-made steel out of the U.S., says Indiana-based Steel Dynamics.  Flat-rolled sheet steel in Asia is selling for about half what U.S. steel buyers are paying for domestic steel, providing an incentive for Asian steelmakers to step up their exports.  On a call with analysts, Steel Dynamics' Chief Operating Officer Barry Schneider warned of intensified competition.
